When `sentence` is blank the section carries no accessible name at all, so it is not exposed as a named landmark; the string «נשימה» appears only in the schema `name` (line 85) and preset (line 96), which are Theme Editor labels, not rendered markup.

The defect no longer exists in the file: the `{% else %} aria-label="נשימה"` branch was in the first build (commit 6e2c01e) and was removed in the deployed pass-2 commit (6ea957e); /home/user/ElmsNest/theme/sections/elmsnest-s-home-band.liquid line 39 now reads `{% if section.settings.sentence != blank %} aria-labelledby="ens-home-band-p-{{ section.id }}"{% endif %}` with no fallback name, which is precisely the proposed fix. The critic was reading a stale revision; acting on it would be a no-op. The SPEC (§1 C, §4) is silent on landmark naming, so the finding is not contract-contrary in itself — just already resolved, and no shopper or owner would notice anything further.
